mcqs.q: In November 2026, which district of Balochistan was the site of a major security operation against groups designated as 'Fitna al Hindustan'?
mcqs.explanation: Security forces killed 15 terrorists in two separate operations in Mastung district as part of Operation Radd-ul-Fitna-3. (Story id 6, 24)

mcqs.q: In November 2026, which official visited India to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum?
mcqs.explanation: Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik attended the SCO forum in New Delhi, becoming the first Pakistani minister to visit India since May 2023. (Story id 5)

mcqs.q: According to the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority, which submarine cable system reported a fault in November 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The SEA-ME-WE 5 (SMW5) cable system experienced a fault approximately 11 kilometres from Pakistan's coast. (Story id 4)

mcqs.q: In November 2026, President Asif Ali Zardari promulgated several ordinances specifically affecting which province?
mcqs.explanation: The President promulgated five ordinances in November 2026 that withdrew most privileges of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa lawmakers. (Story id 3)

mcqs.q: In November 2026, which institution in Sindh was reported to have functioned without a chairman for 18 months?

mcqs.q: What is the primary function of the 'Kangina' method used in Afghanistan?
mcqs.explanation: Kangina is a traditional Afghan method involving clay-and-straw discs used to keep grapes fresh throughout the winter. (Story id 2)

mcqs.q: Which US court sentenced Indian national Nikhil Gupta to 235 months in prison in November 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Nikhil Gupta was sentenced by US District Judge Victor Marrero in the Southern District of New York for a murder-for-hire plot. (Story id 16)

mcqs.q: Between January and October 2026, how many open-heart surgeries did the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases perform?
mcqs.explanation: The institute performed 1,626 open-heart surgeries during the first 10 months of 2026. (Story id 26)

mcqs.q: In November 2026, which country renewed its call to the UN Security Council to sanction the BLA and its Majeed Brigade?
mcqs.explanation: Acting Permanent Representative Sun Lei renewed China's call for the UNSC 1267 Committee to list the BLA and Majeed Brigade. (Story id 14)

mcqs.q: Which Pakistani official demanded 10 billion rupees in damages from Advocate Mian Dawood in November 2026?

mcqs.q: According to the EU's new proposal for a digital tax, what is the annual global turnover threshold for digital companies to be eligible for the tax?
mcqs.explanation: The EU's draft proposal targets companies with an annual global turnover exceeding €750 million and EU digital activity turnover of at least €50 million. (Story id 10)
